findings.evidence: Lines 15-16 vs. the hypothesis at line 56; the theorem's own docstring (lines 52-53) states it correctly: "an additive subgroup stable under the whole Kostant form". `Form.lean:168-169` `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm` is what the proof uses.
findings.fix: Rewrite as: "When `M ≤ V` is stable under `ρ(U_ℤ)`, every divided power of `ρ(eᵢ)` preserves `M`, since those divided powers lie in `U_ℤ`."
findings.issue: The module docstring states the wrong hypothesis: "When a representation `ρ` preserves an additive subgroup `M ≤ V`, every divided power of `ρ(eᵢ)` also preserves `M`." The actual hypothesis (line 56) is `hM : ∀ u ∈ kostantForm e h, ∀ v ∈ M, ρ u v ∈ M` — stability under the image of `U_ℤ`, not under `ρ` as such. `U_ℤ` is introduced on line 14 and then never used, so the file's one point (that Kostant-form stability suffices) is absent from the docstring.

findings.evidence: Line 72: `(hnil : IsNilpotent (ρ (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ (e i))))`; `Kostant/Exponential.lean:16-19`: "A root vector `eᵢ` need not be nilpotent in the enveloping algebra itself — a nonzero Chevalley root vector never is, the enveloping algebra being a domain — but whenever its image under an algebra map `f` is nilpotent — an extra hypothesis throughout".
findings.fix: Add the hypothesis to the module docstring, e.g. "...attached to each root vector `eᵢ` whose image `ρ(eᵢ)` is nilpotent", and mirror it in the `baseChangeKostantExpHom` bullet.
findings.issue: Overclaim: "we obtain the additive one-parameter action of an arbitrary commutative ring `R` on `R ⊗[ℤ] M` attached to each root vector `eᵢ`" (and the bullet at lines 26-27) omits the nilpotency hypothesis `hnil : IsNilpotent (ρ (ι ℚ (e i)))` required by `baseChangeKostantExpHom` (line 72). No action is obtained for a root vector whose image is not nilpotent — and per the sibling file a nonzero root vector is never nilpotent in the enveloping algebra itself, so this is not a vacuous caveat.

findings.evidence: Line 69: `(hM : ∀ v ∈ M, Associative.dividedPower n x v ∈ M)` — a hypothesis on `dividedPower n x`, not on `x`; contrast lines 65-67 of the same docstring.
findings.fix: Reword to "The restriction to `M` of the `n`-th divided power of `x`, given that this divided power maps `M` into `M`."
findings.issue: `integralDividedPower`'s docstring says "the `n`-th divided power of an endomorphism preserving `M`", but `x` is not assumed to preserve `M`; the hypothesis (line 69) only says `Associative.dividedPower n x` maps `M` into `M`. These differ exactly where it matters — `x M ⊆ M` does not give `xⁿ/n! M ⊆ M` — which is the whole reason the divided-power hypothesis is taken as primitive. The second paragraph of the same docstring describes the hypothesis correctly, contradicting the first.

summary: Both files have module and declaration docstrings, but three of them misstate hypotheses: the Kostant module docstring states the wrong stability hypothesis and silently drops the nilpotency hypothesis that every declaration in the file requires, and `integralDividedPower`'s docstring attributes preservation of `M` to `x` rather than to its `n`-th divided power.
